title: Unmatched Dal Makhani in the heart of Amritsar
body: Visited with family during our Golden Temple trip. The slow-simmered dal cooked in ghee for 24 hours has no equal. Absolutely authentic atmosphere!

title: Best shammi kebabs and chocolate mousse in Delhi
body: My grandfather used to buy bread here, and 50 years later the quality has not dropped one bit. The mutton puff is flaky perfection.

title: Perfect remote work spot with artisanal coffee
body: Excellent flat white made with Attikan Estate beans. The seating is comfortable, WiFi is ultra fast, and staff knows their coffee notes.

title: Transparent diagnosis, no unnecessary parts billed
body: Had an electrical issue in my Hyundai Creta that two local garages failed to fix. Bosch engineers diagnosed a faulty sensor in 20 minutes.

title: Painless root canal treatment
body: Top tier hygiene and modern imaging machines. Dr. Priya explained every step on the monitor before beginning.

title: The real Shrewsbury biscuits of Pune
body: Queue starts at 7 AM for a reason! Nothing beats their freshly packed warm biscuits with afternoon tea.
